title: Awakening of the Buddha: Subspace Learning During Population-Loss Plateaus
summary: Population loss can remain nearly constant while a neural network learns a substantially more predictive representation. We establish this separation for two-layer ReLU and leaky-ReLU networks trained on Gaussian inputs by simultaneous fixed-step population gradient descent on all parameters.
